tts.title: Text-to-speech (TTS)
tts.browserHint: Uses your browser/OS built-in speech synthesis. Voice quality and language coverage depend heavily on your system.
tts.webgpuHint: Runs fully on-device, no server involved. First use per language downloads a model and can take several seconds; faster afterwards. Full sentences still sound rougher than the other options, and not every language is available.
tts.speakWhileStreaming: Speak the reply sentence-by-sentence as it streams in, instead of only after it finishes

stt.title: Speech-to-text (STT)
stt.browserPrivacyHint: Note: in Chrome/Chromium, the audio recording is sent to Google's servers for recognition. Choose "Local (WASM)" or "Server" once available for local/private processing.
